## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-6: Regression tests: (a) fixture route produces expected output; (b) absent route map → annotation not soft-pass; (c) 500-route fixture excluded
- dd-7: Unit tests passing

## Implementation Notes
Create tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh. Set chmod +x immediately.

Three named test cases:
1. fixture_route_produces_expected_output: Parse SKILL.md to confirm documented flow; stage fixture route-map.json; verify all 4 precondition strings present in skill + expected output structure documented
2. absent_route_map_yields_annotation_not_soft_pass: Verify SKILL.md documents that absent route-map.json produces visual_eval_inapplicable:route_map_missing (not silent pass)
3. 500_route_fixture_excluded: Verify no 500-route fixture file exists in tests/ that would cause 500 screenshots per CI run; assert exclusion via file-absent check or skip marker

Test uses parsing-based assertions against SKILL.md content + behavioral checks via staged fixtures.
Add .test-index entry: plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/SKILL.md:tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: python3 -m pytest tests/
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Test file exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh
- [ ] All 3 named cases present in test file
  Verify: grep -q 'fixture_route_produces_expected_output' tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh && grep -q 'absent_route_map_yields_annotation_not_soft_pass' tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh && grep -q '500_route_fixture_excluded' tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh
- [ ] Test suite passes
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-visual-evaluator-skill.sh
- [ ] .test-index entry added
  Verify: grep -q 'visual-evaluator/SKILL.md' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
data.title: Add bash regression tests for visual-evaluator skill (3 scenarios)
